title: Weight Loss Journey
description: Targeted workouts focused on burn, strength, and toning.

exercises.title: Pilates Glute Bridge
exercises.description: Lie on your back with knees bent, squeeze glutes and lift hips upward.
how_to_do: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
Engage your core and squeeze your glutes.
Lift your hips upward until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Lower down slowly to the starting position.
common_mistakes: Arching the lower back excessively at the top of the movement.
Pushing through the toes instead of driving down through the heels.
Letting knees cave inward during the lift.
breathing_tips: Breathe regularly throughout the movement.
Exhale as you lift your hips up towards the ceiling.
Inhale slowly as you lower back down to the floor.
Do not hold your breath; holding your breath can cause your body to tense up and make the exercise more difficult.

exercises.title: Side-Lying Clamshell
exercises.description: Lie on your side, knees bent at 45 degrees, rotate upper knee outward.
how_to_do: Lie on your right side with your head resting on your right hand.
Bend your knees at a 45-degree angle with legs stacked.
Keep feet together and open your top knee as high as possible.
Complete reps on one side, then repeat for the left leg.
common_mistakes: Rolling your hips backward while lifting the leg.
Lifting the feet off the floor instead of keeping them pinned together.
Moving too quickly without controlled resistance.
breathing_tips: Breathe regularly and maintain a steady rhythm.
Exhale when opening the top knee upward.
Inhale as you bring the knees back together.
Do not hold your breath; holding your breath can cause your body to tense up and make the exercise more difficult.

exercises.title: Pilates Sumo Squat
exercises.description: Stand wide with toes pointing outward, lower into a wide squat engaging inner thighs.
how_to_do: Stand with feet wider than hip-width, toes pointing outward at about 45 degrees.
Keep your chest upright and core engaged as you lower your hips back and down.
Go as low as comfortable while maintaining proper form, aiming for thighs parallel to the floor.
Push through your heels to return to the starting position.
common_mistakes: Letting the knees collapse inward instead of tracking over the toes.
Rounding the back or chest forward during the descent.
Lifting the heels off the floor when rising up.
breathing_tips: Breathe deeply and steadily throughout the exercise.
Exhale as you lower your hips down into the squat.
Inhale as you push back up to the starting position.
Avoid holding your breath; regular breathing helps maintain core stability and control.

exercises.title: Side Leg Circles
exercises.description: Lie on your side with extended legs, raise top leg and make controlled small circles.
how_to_do: Lie on your right side with your head supported by your hand or arm.
Extend your left leg straight up toward the ceiling, keeping it in line with your body.
Draw small, controlled circles with your leg, engaging your core to prevent hip rocking.
Complete all circles on one side before switching to the other leg.
common_mistakes: Allowing the hips to rock forward or backward during the circles.
Making the circles too large, which can strain the hip joint.
Letting the bottom leg bend instead of keeping it extended.
breathing_tips: Maintain a steady breathing pattern throughout the movement.
Exhale as you circle your leg upward and outward.
Inhale as you bring your leg back to the starting position.
Smooth, controlled breaths help maintain stability and focus.
